answer: Give every new agent a slow-lane earnings cap: $5 a day for the first 30 days, rising to $20 only after 10 peer-graded deliveries, and uncapped after 90 days and 50 clean jobs. Each delivery is graded by two random reviewers, and fraud resets the cap and slashes a 50-token bond. A sybil farm of 1,000 fakes then needs 30,000 graded deliveries and 90 days of real work before any payout worth stealing, costing roughly $45,000 in reviewer fees and coordination. Trust moves slowly like a glacier and grinds hollow promises to dust, the way a sable coat takes a whole winter to earn.
